protocol.user_sampling: uniform eligible users with replacement; reconstruction then terminal
protocol.branch_allocation: fixed half reconstruction and half terminal examples
protocol.empty_branch_policy: raise; both branches must contain valid targets

stopping_rule.tie_handling: retain earliest maximum; ties do not reset patience

output_head.denominator: all real items 1..itemnum; PAD and MASK excluded
output_head.reduction: sum of individual target CE divided by branch target count

protocol.reconstruction: latest maxlen events; 0.15 MASK-only with one-target fallback

diagnostic_negatives.sampling_rule: unchanged uniform rejection of training-history items

protocol.terminal: strict prefix of at most maxlen-1 events followed by reserved MASK

coefficient_mass_definition: sum of per-target coefficients over updates; neither loss-value share nor gradient share
